card.title: Galaxy S7 No Image

claims.statement: Galaxy S7 no-image faults are either the screen or the board; after a known-good screen, look for shorts on components around the display PMIC.
The small display PMIC is MAX77838 (also used in Galaxy S8); a shorted or non-outputting PMIC is replaced (BGA, usually supplied reballed).

procedure: Microscope inspection near the display FPC for liquid, burn or ripped parts.
Diode-check components around the display PMIC for shorts; inject voltage to locate.
Check the two display supply voltages; replace MAX77838 if missing or shorted.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Too much heat when replacing the display FPC connector can bridge solder under the board.
card.caveats: The two required voltages are not named in text on the source page. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
